which is a civilian organization which was organized over a year ago to investigate the subject of flying saucers.
Major Kehoe, would you have a statement to make on the recent flurry of sighting reports?
Yes, Ron, I'd be glad to. These reports, which seem to be very authentic, indicate that an unknown type of object, completely alien to anything that we have made,
The report on this area has been operating at a very low altitude and this machine has some kind of force field which can cut out or affect the circuit of a car, the headlights, radio, TV.

young man who reported that his car radio faded out and then his engine stopped and ten other drivers had the same experience

moving at very high speed, under standard control.
Now, this type of machine was seen, apparently at the same time, in Chicago sometime later,
and the solar objects were seen perhaps two, three days before that over the Fiji Islands.
So there are several of these things, important reports, operating around the Earth.

Well, it's changed so many times, it is hard to tell a job.

of the object as it was described both in Texas and near the White Sands Pooling Ground.
